notes: This manifest implements the Founder-locked SOUL plug-and-play runtime standard for Victor.
Victor uses its own repository-scoped API_VICTOR credential against AWS Bedrock Mantle; RIO secret values are not copied or reused.
Model priority mirrors the proven RIO Bedrock Mantle path: qwen.qwen3-coder-next primary, zai.glm-4.7-flash fallback.
Provider health uses the authenticated model-list endpoint and makes no paid inference request.
A provider is READY only when authentication succeeds and one of the declared models is actually visible to the credential.
